seo.description: Grand Socco (Place du 9 Avril) is Tangier’s hinge between new town and medina — markets, taxis and the main gate into the old city.
seo.keywords: Grand Socco Tangier, Place du 9 Avril, Tangier medina entrance

name: Grand Socco
hero_subtitle: The busy square between new town and medina.

overview.title: Where Tangier switches gear
overview.p1: The Grand Socco — officially Place du 9 Avril 1947 — is the practical entrance to the medina. Taxis, buses of people and market energy meet here before the lanes tighten toward Petit Socco and the kasbah.
overview.p2: Use it as a landmark rather than a long stop: orient, enter the medina, return when you need a taxi. Nearby cinema and park edges add a bit of open space.

q1.question: Is Grand Socco the same as Petit Socco?
q1.answer: No. Grand Socco is the large outer square; Petit Socco is a smaller café square deeper in the medina.

q2.question: Can I leave luggage area taxis here?
q2.answer: It is a common drop-off to enter the medina on foot; confirm with your driver.

q3.question: Is it worth a long stop?
q3.answer: Better as a gateway and meeting point than a half-day destination.

q4.question: Safe at night?
q4.answer: Generally active; stick to lit routes into the medina.

q5.question: Nearby landmarks?
q5.answer: Medina gates, cinema edge and the path toward Petit Socco.
